treatment_summary: Continue lisinopril 10 mg daily for renal protection and BP control. Initiate dapagliflozin 10 mg daily to slow CKD progression and lower CV risk, with glucose monitoring and possible modest insulin dose reduction. Start atorvastatin 20 mg nightly for cardiovascular risk reduction. Discontinue chronic naproxen use and replace with safer analgesia. Monitor eGFR, ACR, potassium, and LFTs as per NG203, and review blood pressure, glycaemia, and lipid targets regularly.
